headline: Israel's next government takes shape
standfirst: The opposition leader has been tasked with forming a new government coalition.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Israel's president officially tasked the opposition leader with forming a new government.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Political maneuvering continues as Gadi Eisenkot signals openness to Netanyahu joining.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: This decision shapes the future of the nation's leadership and its governing coalition.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Look for further announcements as the opposition leader works to build a stable government.

caption:
Israel's opposition leader has been tasked with forming a new government following recent political shifts.

The country is entering a new phase of negotiations. Gadi Eisenkot has indicated he is open to Benjamin Netanyahu joining the upcoming government structure.
